reason: The free first visit is a no-brainer, so I'd try it once with my toddler. After that, we'd maybe go once or twice a month, and $13 a visit plus a pack or membership doesn't add up for us on $38k.
objection: We'd only go once or twice a month, so the $45 membership isn't worth it. $13 a kid every time adds up fast, and I don't know yet if it's actually calm enough for me to get any work done.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper weekday drop-in around $8-9, or a pack that doesn't expire so I can use it at my own pace.
